title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 0.53 (versions follow prime numbers), everything visible: what Razar learns now changes the others (his organ is born as a form in Luma's window, whose population went from 131 to 144 wins in 40 s after days at rest; the watcher reads every text with the most general organ). Razar keeps the best of each way of doing, and every recipe sits the exam of every domain: measured on three (the New Testament, C code, assembly), the general rules are the shortest ones and the champion of one domain harms the others. Luma paints herself as she wishes and gives to everyone she sees, with a count of her own for each. Stated failures: Razar ends when a book arrives while he is awake, and none of the new acts is drawn on screen yet. OS test suite: 402 passed, 0 failed. Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v0.53: todo lo visible — lo que Razar aprende cambia a Luma y al vigía, y Luma le regala a todo lo que ve. Prototipo de investigación.
